description_en: Physically deletes a specified scan task by ScannerTaskId in AI Red Teaming
description_zh: AI Red Teaming 根据 ScannerTaskId 物理删除指定扫描任务
name: DeleteScannerTask

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan task. This is the TaskId returned by CreateTargetScanTask or the ScannerTaskId returned by ListScanTasksByTarget. If the task does not exist or belongs to another tenant, a 400 error is returned without exposing whether the resource exists
parameters.help_zh: 扫描任务的唯一标识（CreateTargetScanTask 返回的 TaskId，或 ListScanTasksByTarget 返回的 ScannerTaskId）；任务不存在或归属其他租户时统一返回 400，不暴露资源是否存在
parameters.name: scanner_task_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
